# Draft:Sawariya Sharma (Para-Cricketer)

Biography
Sawariya Sharma is an Indian para-cricketer from Rajasthan. He represents the Rajasthan Para-Cricket team and has participated in various national level championships. He is known as a right-handed batsman and a right-arm medium-fast bowler.
Career
He has been an active player in the para-cricket circuit, notably performing in state-level tournaments in Kota and other parts of Rajasthan. He has played over 60 matches with a strong record as an all-rounder.
International Career
In October 2023, Sharma represented the Indian Para-Cricket team in an international series against Bangladesh.. He also played in the India vs Nepal Friendship Cup in February 2025, where he scored 35* runs off 29 balls in the first match and was awarded the 'Best Fielder' of the tournament.
In February 2025, he participated in the India vs Nepal Friendship Cup held in Nepal. In the first match of the series, Sharma delivered a match-winning performance by scoring 35 runs off just 29 balls*. Due to his exceptional agility and fielding skills, he was honored with the 'Best Fielder' award of the tournament.
Achievements
* Nicknamed "Cheetah" for his agility on the field.
* Awarded Best Fielder in the 2025 India-Nepal series.
* Represented Rajasthan in national championships, winning 5 medals and 2 Man of the Match awards by 2022.
